en.name: Electro Mage
en.ability: 1 alive player is poisoned, if they nominate, the nominee is instead. Evil can't be poisoned by this. [+0 or -1 Outsider]

revisions.v1: 1 alive player is poisoned, if they nominate, the nominee is instead. Evil can't be poisoned by this. [+0 or -1 Outsider]

en.flavor: Since you want to play, let’s call more friends♪~
en.firstNightReminder: Places a "poisoned" marker on an alive player. If a player with the "poisoned" mark nominate, move the "poisoned" mark next to the nominated player character mark.
en.otherNightReminder: If the player with the "poisoned" mark dies or no poisoned players, place a "poisoned" mark on an alive player. If a player with the "poisoned" mark initiates a nomination, move the "poisoned" mark next to the nominated player character mark.
